activities:
CREATE TABLE `activities` (
 `id` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 `seed_id` VARCHAR(255) NULL,
 `slug` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 `status` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
 `activity_type` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
 `title` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
 `description` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
 `starts_at` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 `ends_at` VARCHAR(32) NULL,
 `venue` LONGTEXT NULL,
 `modality` LONGTEXT NULL,
 `organizer` LONGTEXT NULL,
 `participants` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
 `source_url` LONGTEXT NULL,
 `media` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
 `materials` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
 `published` BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (1),
 `created_at` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
 `updated_at` VARCHAR(32) NULL,
 `programme` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
 `content` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (''),

 UNIQUE KEY `activities_seed_id_unique` (`seed_id`),

article_comments:
CREATE TABLE `article_comments` (
 `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 `post_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
 `email` VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
 `body` LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
 `status` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('published'),
 `created_at` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
 `updated_at` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
 `parent_id` BIGINT NULL,
 `quote` LONGTEXT NULL,
 `source_urls` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('[]'),
 `relation` LONGTEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('claim'),
 `deleted_at` VARCHAR(32) NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 KEY `idx_comments_post_status_date` (`post_id`,`status`,`created_at`),
 KEY `idx_comments_email_date` (`email`,`created_at`),
 KEY `idx_comments_parent` (`parent_id`),
 CONSTRAINT `fk_article_comments_post_id` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `editorial_posts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 CONSTRAINT `fk_article_comments_email` FOREIGN KEY (`email`) REFERENCES `reader_profiles` (`email`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;
